entries.title: Romans 13:1
segments: Every one should be in the higher authorities; for there is no authority apart from God. The authorities that now exist have been appointed by God.

entries.title: Romans 13:2
segments: Therefore the man who rebels against authority is opposing the divine ordinances; and those who withstand will bring judgment on themselves.

entries.title: Romans 13:3
segments: For rulers are no terror to good deeds, but to evil. Would you be fearless of the ruler's authority? Do what is good, and you will have his praise.

entries.title: Romans 13:4
segments: For the ruler is God's minister appointed for your good. But if you are a wrong-doer, be afraid; he does not carry the sword to no purpose; he is God's servant, appointed to vengeance upon the guilty.

entries.title: Romans 13:5
segments: Wherefore you must needs be in subjection, not only because of fear, but also for conscience sake.

entries.title: Romans 13:6
segments: This too, is the reason why you pay taxes; because the authorities are ministers of God's service, attending continually upon this very thing.

entries.title: Romans 13:7
segments: Render to all their dues; taxes to whom taxes, customs to whom customs, respect to whom respect, and homage to whom homage is due.

entries.title: Romans 13:8
segments: Never owe any one anything save the debt of brotherly love; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the Law.

entries.title: Romans 13:9
segments: For the Law which says, Thou shalt not commit adultery, thou shalt do no murder, thou shalt not steal, thou shalt not bear false witness, thou shalt not covet, and whatever other commandment there be--is all summed up in this one saying, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

entries.title: Romans 13:10
segments: Love never wrongs his neighbor; therefore love is the fulfilment of the Law.

entries.title: Romans 13:11
segments: Carry out these injunctions because you know the crisis that we are in, that now it is high time for you to awake out of sleep; for now is our salvation nearer than when we first believed.

entries.title: Romans 13:12
segments: The night is far spent; The day is at hand. Let is therefore take off the deeds of darkness, Let us put on the armor of light.

entries.title: Romans 13:13
segments: Let us live honestly, as in the day, Not in reveling and drunkenness, Not in lust and licentiousness, Not is strife and jealousy;

entries.title: Romans 13:14
segments: But clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, And make no provisions for your earthly nature And the gratification of its lusts.
